Naya the Secretive

Biography

Naya is Estera’s apprentice and has long hunted on her teacher’s behalf. Estera offers her help to Zak as a test of her training. Naya wants her abilities respected and hopes one day to succeed Estera and teach an apprentice of her own. [1, 2, 3]
